note: Console configuration checklist; not an API request payload.
gpu: RTX 4090 (24 GB, compute capability 8.9), initial low-VRAM benchmark; 48 GB Ada fallback if necessary
apiKey: Restricted to this endpoint; create in RunPod Credentials. Never bake into the worker image.
externalS3: Set S3_BUCKET, S3_ENDPOINT_URL (omit for AWS S3), S3_REGION, S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID and S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY as runtime environment variables/secrets. The network volume is only a model cache in this mode.
